news.text: — Cooper Flagg had 29 points and 11 assists, plus blocked a shot that would have given Miami the lead in the final moments, and the Dallas Mavericks sent the reeling Heat to 0-4 with a 113-109 win on Monday night.

news.title: Wembanyama, Harper lead Spurs past short-handed Mavericks 122-106 for their first victory
news.text: — Victor Wembanyama had 23 points, seven rebounds and four blocks, Dylan Harper scored 22 points and the San Antonio Spurs beat the Dallas Mavericks 122-106 on Saturday night for their first victory of the season.

news.title: Mavericks' Cooper Flagg out for home opener with mild left shoulder sprain
news.text: Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced. He will not play against the Spurs.

news.text: — Kyrie Irving scored 24 points and the Dallas Mavericks overcame the loss of Cooper Flagg to spoil Tyrese Haliburton 's home return for the Indiana Pacers in a 121-105 victory Friday...

news.title: Mavericks' Cooper Flagg lands on shoulder after hard foul, exits win vs. Pacers
news.text: Mavericks forward Cooper Flagg did not play in the second half Friday night at Indiana after landing hard on his left shoulder after Aaron Nesmith tried to block his shot from behind to prevent a breakaway dunk.

news.title: Kyrie Irving hounded by Rockets in return, held in check in Mavs' blowout loss
news.text: With the Rockets focused on trapping him, Kyrie Irving was held to 15 points in his first regular-season game since March 2025 and the Mavs fell 128-110.

news.title: Rockets' Tari Eason ejected after shoving Mavericks' P.J. Washington in back
news.text: Rockets reserve forward Tari Eason was ejected in the first quarter Wednesday night after shoving Mavericks forward P.J. Washington in the back.

news.title: Durant and Smith each score 30 points to power the Rockets past the Mavericks 128-110 in the opener
news.text: — Kevin Durant and Jabari Smith Jr. scored 30 points apiece and the Houston Rockets used a big second quarter to build a huge lead and coast to a 128-110 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.
